input.source_snapshot: exact immutable repository commit, evidence-backed and unchanged across candidate
input.baseline_markdown: read from exact snapshot or exact PR-parent HEAD

readability_budget.overrides: explicit consumer/human review; no implicit bypass

diagram.type: bounded caller-declared graph with title, caption, nodes and edges
diagram.nodes: 2..24 unique safe IDs; label and exact source-inventory evidence_path per node
diagram.edges: 1..40 declared source, target, label and evidence_path; endpoints must be known
diagram.output: fenced Mermaid flowchart LR, textual caption, sorted witness list and semantic limitation
diagram.semantic_authority: no inferred relationships; source inventory witness does not prove the relation

gates.required: preserve all baseline Markdown link target occurrences, existing Markdown heading anchors including duplicates, and local fragment targets
gates.readability: bounded document growth and maximum table row length; failures reported with issue codes
gates.html_heading_rule: Raw HTML h1..h6 tags are NOT presumed to auto-generate GitHub Markdown anchors
gates.anchor_alias: Recognize explicit a id/name anchors; source mutation still requires independent authorization
gates.implementation_limit: Conservative Markdown subset, not complete GitHub CommonMark parser; rendered GitHub view remains review gate
gates.domain_meaning: Not verified by this runtime; semantic/policy claims require consumer authority
gates.location: read-only post-render audit before authorized GitHub mutation
gates.diagrams: opt-in only; reject unsafe Mermaid content, unknown source paths and unwitnessed edges; run the same v0.2 post-render audit and human GitHub rendering/meaning review

result.pass: no issues; still not proof of semantic or full GFM equivalence
